package requests

import (
	"example.com/remote-test/game/view"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
)

var _ view.Alliance

// Query 由入口填入可信引用；两个 handler 共用同一个 DTO。
type Query struct {
	AllianceViewRef entity.RemoteViewRef `remote:"view.Alliance,consistency=monotonic,required"`
	Done            chan int64
}
type Optional struct {
	AllianceViewRef entity.RemoteViewRef `remote:"view.Alliance,consistency=cached"`
}
